description: List all Swiss dams under federal supervision in a given canton. Returns up to 20 dams with basic details. Data source: Swiss Federal Office of Energy (SFOE) via swisstopo BGDI.

canton.description: Swiss canton 2-letter abbreviation code (e.g. 'VS' for Valais, 'GR' for Graubünden, 'BE' for Bern, 'UR' for Uri, 'TI' for Ticino, 'VD' for Vaud).

name: get_dams_by_canton
